DECLARE @j json=N'{"a":[1,2,3]}', @v int=2, @p nvarchar(40)=N'$.a[*]'; SELECT JSON_CONTAINS(@j,@v,@p) AS found; SELECT x FROM (VALUES(1),(2),(4)) t(x) WHERE JSON_CONTAINS(@j,x,@p)=1 ORDER BY x;

CREATE TABLE t(id int,j json); INSERT t VALUES(1,N'{"x":2}'),(2,N'{"x":3}'),(3,NULL); SELECT id,JSON_CONTAINS(j,2,'$.x') AS found FROM t ORDER BY id; UPDATE t SET j.modify('$.x',4) WHERE JSON_CONTAINS(j,2,'$.x')=1; SELECT id,CAST(j AS nvarchar(max)) AS j FROM t ORDER BY id;
